bugs.summary: previous_defs changed from a list of int depths to a list of Line objects, but an existing condition still used `self.previous_defs[-1]` as a truthy depth check. A Line object is always truthy, so the condition no longer tests that the previous def was nested, and it should use `.depth`.
bugs.trigger: Format non-stub code where a top-level compound statement follows a def: the check is always true for Line objects, so blank lines are inserted/removed wrongly (fix #3615 uses .depth).
